==Description==
The '''Sleigh''' was an enemy that appeared on Wave 20 in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a decent amount of health, average speed and moderate defense. It also flew on a sleigh, meaning that it could not collide with most units, as well as being undetectable by a majority of towers and units.

==Appearance==
The '''Sleigh''' was a brownish orange and white sleigh. It had golden rims along most of its structure, as well as golden thrusters on the back of its feet. It had yellow headlights and small wings as well. The sleigh was piloted by an elf with pale skin. It had a green shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black belt, dark green pants and black shoes. It also wore a green Christmas hat.

==Strategy==
*The '''Sleigh''' appears in hordes alongside many other enemies and [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]].
**The [[Mortar]] is a strong option against the '''Sleigh''', as well as being strong against all hordes in general. Its long range also ensures that the '''Sleigh''' does not get past your defenses.
**The [[Executioner]] is strong for the same reasons the [[Mortar]] is, though with the added benefit of being a good option early game.
**The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can also deal with the '''Sleigh''', as well as having strong single-target damage against enemies like [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]].
